title: China Emerges as Both a Beauty Powerhouse and a Major Consumer Market
summary: China\'s cosmetics industry is entering a new phase of global relevance.According to September trade data released by China\'s General Administration of Customs, the country\'s cosmetics exports reached 2.10 billion yuan, up 47.0% year-on-year, while cosmetics imports climbed 13.0% to 8.64 billion yuan

extraction.key_fact: 중국 화장품 수출이 수입보다 훨씬 빠르게 늘면서 중국 뷰티 브랜드의 해외 확장이 두드러졌다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: China's cosmetics exports significantly outpaced import growth in September, underlining the rapid international expansion of Chinese beauty brands.
